post.description: Authenticates a browser session. Returns a complete login payload, or a two-factor checkpoint token when the account requires a second factor.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of servers the authenticated user can access as an owner, subuser, or administrator.

parameters.description: Number of servers to return per page. The maximum is 100.

parameters.description: Scope of servers to return. "owner" returns owned servers, "admin" returns admin-accessible servers excluding owned or subuser servers, and "admin-all" returns all servers for root administrators.
